technical.summary: Long-term structure bullish but short-term momentum absent; price below key moving averages, weak volume, and negative money flow create conflicting signals unsuitable for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 45 days present material risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for ACN; mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 2 purchases) in small amounts, neutral market fear/greed, and unavailable news sentiment provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (93.68) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 45 days adds binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure remains bullish (EMA 50/200 bullish, Supertrend bullish, price above Ichimoku cloud) with price near support (293.80) offering defined risk entry for mean-reversion traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical confluence of bearish factors—price below all short-term moving averages, negative money flow, MACD bearish crossover, weak volume, VIX crisis levels (93.68), inverted yield curve, and earnings binary risk in 45 days—overwhelm long-term structure and create unacceptable swing-trade risk.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term structure (EMA 50/200, Supertrend, Ichimoku) remains bullish and price sits near support (293.80), offering defined-risk mean-reversion setup. However, this rationale is overwhelmed by macro severity and short-term momentum collapse.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis levels (93.68), inverted yield curve, and earnings binary event in 45 days create unacceptable swing-trade risk; price below all short-term MAs with negative money flow and MACD bearish cross signal imminent weakness.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias; technical, fundamental, sentiment, and risk all point to avoidance
decision.portfolio_note: Existing ACN position plus 6 other IT holdings in 52-position portfolio creates sector concentration; adding exposure violates diversification discipline and increases drawdown risk in macro crisis environment.
